node.title: Re: non-ASCII characters in text->Excel
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: You'll have to tell us a little more about the problem - best would be a [id://1177642] that reproduces the issue, so that we can see the problem for ourselves, including what module(s) you're using, how you're handling the string, how you've [id://1233709|verified] that the encodings are correct, and so on.
